notes.title: Patch 1.0
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I saw your feedback and I made some improvements to the game, this new patch contains the following bug fixes and improvements:

Improvements:
1. Added a level select screen with level buttons that get unlocked after you finish the correspondent level.
2. Disabled player shadow and added a blob shadow so you will better see, while in the air, where you are about to land.
3. Added more checkpoints in levels.
4. Made the spikes on the ground more visible.
5. Increased the time for collapsing platforms(they now collapse after 2 seconds instead of 0.5 seconds)
6. Changed the free-look camera to strafe mode so you can only see the player from behind, making controlling the player more easy.
7. General visual and performance improvements.

Bug Fixes:
1. Solved a bug where the Checkpoint sound was playing repeatedly while the player ran in and out of the Checkpoint area.
2. Solved a bug in level 8 where you got killed if you touched one of the moving walls.
3. Solved a bug where the jump sound was played every time you pressed the jump button(now the sound is played just if the player jumps).
